subject: Ship Puzzle
text: While riding the Ship, stopping, holding the A Button, and pressing the B Button 55 times unlocks a sliding puzzle solved by listing the numbers from 1 to 15.

evidence.quote:
While riding on the Ship, stop moving, hold the A Button, and then press the
B Button 55 times.  This will unlock a sliding puzzle that is solved by
listing the numbers in order from 1 to 15 (row one = 1-4, row two = 5-8, row
three = 9-12, row four = 13-15).

subject: Ship Puzzle
text: Winning the Ship sliding puzzle awards 100 Gold Pieces, which is repeatedly collectable.

evidence.quote:
Upon winning, you will gain 100 Gold
Pieces!  This is repeatedly collectable, but is far faster to just bash the
enemies around for Gold AND Experience instead of this (fun to play though 
as an occasional diversion).

subject: Power Peninsula
text: Walking north onto the tip of the peninsula east of Pravoka allows fighting strong enemies using hit-all spells like Fir2 or Hrm2 for large amounts of Gold and Experience.

evidence.quote:
After you have been to pravoka and then Elfland, purchase a hit every enemy
spell like Fir2 or Hrm2 and head east from Pravoka (Fir2 is much preferable, 
however).  Walk north onto the tip of the peninsula and patrol there until 
an enemy attacks.  The enemies are super strong, but with the hit all spells 
they are quite beatable, giving large amounts of Gold and Experience!

subject: Zombie D
text: After obtaining the TAIL, stepping off and stepping back to repeatedly fight Zombie D offers a fast and relatively safe method to gain Experience and Gold.

evidence.quote:
Since they are undead and rather easy to kill, after you gain the TAIL and
still have spell charges, step off and step back to fight them again and
again for a fast and relatively safe way to gain Experience and Gold!

subject: Eye
text: Trekking into the Ice Cave with ProRings to the FLOATER room allows fighting the Eye repeatedly for massive amounts of Experience and Gold without worrying about instant-kill attacks.

evidence.quote:
Once you have ProRings, trek into the Ice Cave to go to the locale where you
found the FLOATER.  You can then proceed to wail on the Eye over and over
for massive amounts of Experience and Gold in a short amount of time while
not worrying about it's one hit kill attacks!

subject: Black Belt
text: A Black Belt or Master's Absorb resets to their level upon leveling up, requiring armor to be re-equipped to retain higher Absorb than their level.

evidence.quote:
A Black Belt/Master can wear armor and it will effect his Absorb total, but
it will be reset to a number equal to his level if a level-up occurs.  If 
you wish to have Armor on that will have a higher Absorb than your level, 
then you will need to re-equip it every time one of the two stipulations 
above occurs.

subject: Armor
text: Armor with special battle effects, such as ProRings protecting against Rub, continues to function despite the Black Belt defense bug.

evidence.quote:
Also note that Armor worn with special in battle effects will 
still function despite the bug being in place (ProRings will still protect 
against Rub for example).

subject: Running
text: Characters in the top two party positions can run perfectly when they have more than 15 Luck and a healthy party member two positions down.

evidence.quote:
Running is supposed to be based on your Luck and your level, but it is 
instead based on your Luck and the status of the character two positions 
lower.  This means that characters in the top two positions can run 
perfectly when they have more than 15 Luck and a healthy party member two 
positions down.

subject: Running
text: For the third and fourth character, running success rate is based on Luck and a randomly fluctuating value.

evidence.quote:
For the third and fourth character, their run rate is based on their Luck 
and a randomly fluctuating value that nobody has determined the use of.

text: Skipping starred chests in a dungeon walkthrough allows empty chests in that specific dungeon to contain valuable equipment and items.

evidence.quote:
Empty Chests are annoying when happened upon, but did you know that they 
could contain valuable equipment and Items?  Well, to determine where they
appear (and how to make them hold an Item), make note of the "*" beside a
treasure listing below, indicating which treasure to skip in the walkthrough
for that specific dungeon, allowing for this trick to work.

subject: Lava
text: Walking on lava in Gurgu Volcano prevents random encounters, and since damage tiles cannot reduce HP below 1, it can be used to avoid damage.

evidence.quote:
If a party already has low HP, the damage squares can be helpful, as you 
will never have encounters if you walk on lava.  Due to this, your HP will 
never lower below 1, it can actually be used to avoid damage.

subject: Door
text: Opening the menu screen while standing on a door causes the door to reappear upon return, and walking down may double the door on screen.

evidence.quote:
If you go into the menu screen while standing on a door, when you come back 
the door will reappear on you. Sometimes if you walk down, the door will 
double on screen.
